name: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc.
monetization: Investment bank; monetizes AI via lending and underwriting fees — SoftBank's OpenAI-collateralized loans, the $38B Vantage/Oracle project package, advisory on mega-financings (Saline Township), and structuring for Nvidia's >$500B customer-financing coalition.
description_md: Goldman Sachs is a global investment bank whose AI-cycle franchise is credit and structuring rather than principal equity: it lends into the largest AI project-finance and margin-loan syndicates and advises on the record data-center packages. Its research also tracks the sector's shift to debt funding (AI capex debt-issuance share rising from ~26% in 2025 toward ~33%+ in 2026).
ai_monetization_md: AI-exposure thesis: earn fees and spread on the AI credit wave while syndicating most of the risk. Positions: lender in the JPMorgan/MUFG-led $38B senior secured facilities for Vantage's Texas and Wisconsin campuses serving Oracle/OpenAI (Oct 2025, the largest AI project-debt package to date); Goldman Sachs Bank USA is in SoftBank's $10B margin loan collateralized by its OpenAI stake (Aug 2026); advisor on Related Digital's $16.3B Saline Township financing; and one of six founding financiers in Nvidia's >$500B compute-collateralized customer-financing coalition (Aug 10, 2026, subject to final agreements).
risk_notes_md: Direct hold sizes are undisclosed — bank syndicate shares are typically distributed, but warehouse and bridge periods concentrate risk at announcement. Collateral quality is the open question: OpenAI private shares (margin loan) and GPUs/compute contracts (coalition) are both priced off the same AI cycle. Chicago Fed work puts bank C&I commitments to AI-adjacent industries near 25% of Tier 1 capital sector-wide.

observations.notes: Total package size ($23.25B Texas + $14.75B Wisconsin facilities), JPMorgan/MUFG-led with Goldman, BNP Paribas, SocGen, SMBC, Wells Fargo; Goldman's share undisclosed.
